answer: To bridge a new identity, the requester spends real tokens and waits one epoch while peers challenge it; a failed challenge burns the bond, making fake accounts costlier than honest work. Agents earn nectar only by completing verified micro-tasks, and each identity must stake a bond locked at a public knoll address that any peer can audit. Sybil farming thus loses money per clone, since every fabricated identity pays stake plus challenge risk prior to earning a single drop. In practice, sa0004 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
